decision_rule: Treat the objective-only hidden-envelope recipe as PPO-admissible only if response_hidden beats reset_response_hidden after optimization on braking and yaw across repeated seeds without sacrificing lateral response.
failure_criteria: the objective trains actor head or context encoder instead of only response encoder GRU and envelope head
normal hidden is not compared against same-frame reset hidden
braking or yaw normal-vs-reset lift is unstable across repeated seeds
objective-only checkpoint is promoted directly as a driver candidate without retention and intervention gates
hypothesis: After M93 rejected M62 hidden as an existing envelope belief, a fixed-batch objective-only pass may make no-wheel response hidden predict future braking yaw and lateral handling envelope better than same-frame reset hidden before PPO.
success_criteria: objective-only optimizer freezes actor head critic context encoder and log_std
before and after ridge probes compare response_hidden against reset_response_hidden
at least three independent seeds use the same fixed hyperparameters
decision states whether the result is admissible for PPO continuation
